summary: Mamba 2FA is a Phishing-as-a-Service (PhaaS) kit with Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) capabilities targeting services like Microsoft 365. It uses convincing phishing pages with a distinct URL structure and HTML attachments to steal credentials and bypass MFA by capturing session data in real-time. Post-compromise actions include creating email rules and registering new authenticators for persistence.
